status: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-11-14 before any analysis of the Hillstrom data. Edit only by writing v2.
purpose: Methodological demonstration of what a RANDOMIZED marketing test identifies. Different retailer (apparel, 2008), channel (email) and outcome window (2 weeks): its effects must NEVER be used as grocery coupon uplift or to change the Frozen Pizza plan.

source.terms: none stated on the source page (checked 2026-11-14): raw file kept local and NOT committed

outcomes.note: conversion is rare; report CIs and a sample-size warning

uplift_model.type: two-model (T-learner) logistic regression, C=1.0, standardised numeric + one-hot categorical; no tuning
uplift_model.treatment_pair: Womens E-Mail vs No E-Mail (and Mens vs No as a second, separately reported model)

baselines: random targeting (= overall ATE x n)
recency rule: lowest recency months first
policy_evaluation.estimator: within the targeted set, mean(visit | treated) - mean(visit | control); household bootstrap 500 draws
